verdict.rationale: Tailscale's mesh architecture is designed for direct peer-to-peer WireGuard connections (docs-5, docs-7/8, comm-1/6/18 confirm real users SSH into boxes and access home labs directly, bypassing traditional VPN gateways), but community evidence shows this isn't absolute: NAT traversal sometimes fails and traffic falls back to Tailscale's DERP relay servers, degrading speed (comm-10, comm-7), and some networks now block Tailscale's control/relay ports entirely (comm-11). So while the core promise of direct connectivity is real and well-regarded, it's not guaranteed relay-free in all conditions.
